calls.title: Thomas Schlaier and James Shannon
calls.summary: The meeting discussed the non-functional status of the existing GrowthBook implementation, emphasizing the need for a fresh setup to enable dynamic paywalls and A/B testing. Thomas Schlaier highlighted previous complications with integrating GrowthBook after switching to a headless CMS, leading to a breakdown in A/B testing. The team expressed a preference for a clean re-implementation with technical consulting from GrowthBook, which was affirmed by James Shannon. The conversation also covered product usage across multiple platforms requiring SDK integration and the current PRO plan with potential for modest growth in seats. The client is looking for a support package prior to signing, balancing flexibility and ongoing guidance. Goals to finalize a decision and contract by end of July were also set.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, implementation, headless CMS, dynamic paywalls, AB testing, Enterprise plan
calls.action_items:
**James Shannon**
Send email detailing differences between PRO and Enterprise plans with focus on features and support (26:35)
Provide two pricing options: full Enterprise annual plan and one-time implementation support, both with end of July signing deadline (26:35)
Follow up with GrowthBook support lead Natasha Lee regarding ongoing discussion and questions from NPG (26:14)

**Maxie**
Confirm exact current GrowthBook subscription plan and seat usage internally (22:19)

**Thomas Schlaier**
Coordinate internal review of GrowthBook support requirements and ensure availability of development resources for upcoming implementation (08:57)
